g.text: L1 100+ FORMAT RUST DOC ENGINE
xberg-io/xberg
★ 9,615 · 616 forks · Rust · MIT
• Fast, precise Rust document-intelligence
engine extracting text, tables & metadata
• Supports 100+ formats with OCR & transcription
• Polyglot bindings for every major language
Best for: High-Speed Enterprise Document Ingestion
L2 UNIFIED GRAPH + VECTOR OLTP DB
HelixDB/helix-db
★ 6,313 · 402 forks · Rust · Apache-2.0
• Rust OLTP graph database with native vector
and full-text search on Object Storage
• Eliminates syncing Neo4j + Qdrant + Elastic
• Low-cost S3/MinIO object storage persistence
Best for: Single-Engine GraphRAG + Vector Storage
L3 MULTI-TENANT KNOWLEDGE AGENT OS
xerrors/Yuxi
★ 7,732 · 1,282 forks · Python · MIT
• "Yuxi = Cloud Agents + Knowledge RAG" under MIT
• Unifies RAG, Knowledge Graphs, LangGraph
multi-agents, MCP/Skills, sandbox & RBAC
• Gives every enterprise user a private Cloud Agent
Best for: Self-Hosted Enterprise Knowledge Hub
L4 RAG-GROUNDED TEXT-TO-SQL BI
dataease/SQLBot
★ 7,205 · 958 forks · JS · NOASSERTION
• Conversational BI & Text-to-SQL system
grounded in schema + metric RAG
• Natural-language data querying & charts
• Reduces hallucinated SQL joins & column names
Best for: Conversational Enterprise BI & Analytics
END-TO-END ENTERPRISE DOCUMENT EXTRACTION, UNIFIED GRAPHRAG DB, MULTI-TENANT WORKSPACE & TEXT-TO-SQL (L1 ➔ L4)
1. Polyglot Document Extraction (xberg ★9.6k): Parse tables, OCR text & metadata from 100+ document formats at native Rust speed.
2. Object-Storage Graph + Vector DB (HelixDB ★6.3k): Store graph edges, vector embeddings & full-text indexes in one Rust engine on S3/MinIO.
3. Multi-Tenant Knowledge Agent Workspace (Yuxi ★7.7k): Serve RBAC-governed Cloud Agents with RAG, Knowledge Graphs & MCP/Skills.
4. RAG-Grounded Text-to-SQL (SQLBot ★7.2k): Let executives query structured relational warehouses via schema/glossary-grounded SQL generation.
CLOSED-FORM FINOPS TCO MODEL (45-PERSON DATA, KNOWLEDGE & BI ENGINEERING TEAM · SYNTHETIC WORKLOAD MODEL)
• Path A (Cloud OCR APIs + Separate Managed Graph/Vector DBs + Commercial Conversational BI): $4,910.00/mo + 46.0h ($4,600.00) = $9,510.00/mo
• Path B (Azure Document Intelligence + Cosmos DB + Power BI Copilot): $1,900.00/mo PaaS + 10.5h ($1,050.00) = $2,950.00/mo
• Path C (xberg + HelixDB + Yuxi + SQLBot): $70.00/mo Compute + 2.4h ($240.00) = $310.00/mo (Saves $9,200.00/mo · -96.74%)
